ImageDescription.value: A U.S. Air Force C-17 Globemaster III aircraft flies over the pyramids of Giza in Cairo, Egypt, Oct. 15, 2009, during exercise Bright Star. Bright Star, a biennial multinational exercise conducted by U.S. Central Command, is designed to improve readiness and interoperability and strengthen the military and professional relationships among participating forces.
